newsitem.title: USA: Westinghouse to hold news conference Wed.
newsitem.headline: Westinghouse to hold news conference Wed.

text.p: Westinghouse Electric Corp said on Tuesday it would hold a news conference in New York Wednesday at 1400 EST/1900 GMT.

It declined to say whether the news conference, to be held at the CBS building in midtown Manhattan, was called to announce a split of the company into separate media and industrial operations. Such a split has been the subject of speculation.
Westinghouse shares rose 5/8 to end at 20-5/8 on Tuesday after heavy trading in the stock.
